pages.title: Giant Capybara
pages.text: $(o)Neochoerus$() ($(o)Neochoerus pinckneyi$()) was a giant capybara that lived in North and South America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was about twice the weight of a living capybara and lived along rivers and marshes much like its modern relative.$(br2)It disappeared at the end of the last ice age.
